title: Higher Studies: GATE, M.Tech, MS Abroad and Research
summary: This path is for students who want a master's or PhD after B.Tech: GATE for M.Tech at IITs and NITs, GRE and an English test for MS abroad, or a research route towards a PhD. It suits students who like going deep into one subject.
outcomes: M.Tech student at an IIT, NIT or IIIT
MS student at a university abroad

nodes.title: Choose your path: M.Tech, MS abroad or research
nodes.summary: Decide early which route fits you: GATE and M.Tech in India, an MS abroad with GRE and an English test, or a research degree. GATE can be written from your third year, so plan from second year.

resources.title: Research your options: graduate study – EducationUSA

nodes.proof: A one-page plan naming your target route, two backup options and the official pages you will track.

sources.title: Research your options: graduate study – EducationUSA

nodes.title: Pick your GATE paper and read its syllabus
nodes.summary: GATE has separate papers by discipline. Pick the paper that matches your branch (AIML and DS students can also look at the Data Science and AI paper) and read the official syllabus, which was revised for GATE 2027.

nodes.proof: A checklist of every syllabus topic in your paper, marked strong, weak or not started.

nodes.title: Engineering maths, core subjects and aptitude
nodes.summary: Study engineering mathematics, your core branch subjects and general aptitude topic by topic, following the syllabus. Free NPTEL lectures from IIT faculty cover the maths part well.
nodes.proof: Your own short notes for each syllabus topic, with ten solved problems per topic.

sources.title: GATE 2027 test papers and syllabus – IIT Madras

nodes.title: Previous papers and mock test practice
nodes.summary: Solve official previous GATE papers under timed conditions and use the official mock tests to get used to the computer-based interface. Track your mistakes topic by topic.

resources.title: Sample and previous question papers – GATE 2026, IIT Guwahati
Mock test links – GATE 2025, IIT Roorkee

nodes.proof: A log of at least ten timed full papers with scores and a list of weak topics you fixed.

nodes.title: Register for and write GATE
nodes.summary: GATE is a computer-based test. For GATE 2027, Indian nationals must register through DigiLocker. Check the official site for dates and notices, since they change every year. The score stays valid for three years.
nodes.proof: Your GATE scorecard, with a list of the M.Tech programmes and PSUs you plan to apply to.

nodes.title: M.Tech admission through COAP and CCMT
nodes.summary: For IITs, apply on each institute's own portal, then accept offers on COAP (COAP is not an application portal). For NITs, IIITs and other institutes, one CCMT form covers all eligible programmes. Read each year's brochure.
nodes.proof: A shortlist of programmes with your COAP registration and CCMT choice list ready before the rounds open.

nodes.title: GRE and an English test (IELTS or TOEFL)
nodes.summary: Many universities abroad ask for the GRE General Test (verbal, quantitative and analytical writing) and an English test such as IELTS or TOEFL. Check each university's own requirements. Use the free official practice tests first.

resources.title: Free IELTS practice and sample tests – British Council

nodes.proof: Scores from two full official practice tests in each exam you plan to take.

sources.title: About the GRE General Test – ETS

nodes.title: Shortlist universities and apply for MS
nodes.summary: Start researching 12 to 18 months before you want to begin. Shortlist programmes, compare costs, and look for teaching or research assistantships. Many scholarships cover only part of the cost.

resources.title: Research and narrow your options: graduate – EducationUSA

nodes.proof: A spreadsheet of 8–12 programmes with requirements and funding options, plus a reviewed statement of purpose.

nodes.title: Research path: MS (by research) or PhD
nodes.summary: Learn how research works (literature survey, data analysis, technical writing) and read IIT PhD brochures. IIT Hyderabad, for example, takes some B.Tech graduates directly into a PhD; rules differ by institute. PMRF is a national fellowship for PhD scholars.
nodes.proof: A two-page literature review on one topic and a list of three faculty whose work matches your interest.

nodes.title: Scholarships from official government schemes
nodes.summary: Check official schemes only: the AICTE PG Scholarship for GATE-qualified M.Tech students, the National Overseas Scholarship and Telangana ePASS overseas schemes for eligible categories, and PMRF for PhD. Read the current guidelines every year.
